# `round`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
round(expr, d)
```

Returns `expr` rounded to `d` decimal places using HALF_UP rounding mode.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT round(2.5, 0);
```

Result:

```text
3
```
